reason: A DSH web plugin for language-learning voice practice, combining bilingual conversational guidance, text-to-speech playback, and microphone speech input.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 对话添加语音练习模式，支持双语回复、朗读播放和麦克风语音输入。
summaries.en: Adds a voice-practice mode to DSH Web conversations with bilingual replies, text-to-speech playback, and microphone speech input.

capabilities: Adds a voice-practice mode to DSH conversations
Uses browser microphone speech recognition for voice input
Synthesizes speech through the Microsoft Edge TTS service with browser speech fallback
Injects practice-mode guidance into the conversation system prompt
Stores client preferences in browser localStorage and caches synthesized audio on disk
